name: Photo Studio
description: Take beautiful screenshots: a free camera, freeze the whole scene, pose anyone, portrait and square photos, looks and lights — and hide yourself or any effects.
author: Stellar

media.caption: The Photo Studio panel next to a frozen boss fight — the free camera orbits anyone you pick.
A posed group photo taken with Photo Studio.
Portrait photos are drawn in the tall shape at full detail, not cropped.

added: Hide yourself in photos: "Me" hides your character together with your pet and your Battle Imagine, on your screen only — you can still move and fight.

Hide effects by who caused them: Mine (including your pet's and Battle Imagine's), Party, Other players and Monsters (including boss warning areas). Scenery is never hidden, and everything comes back when you switch it off.
The free camera can hide you and your chosen effects as soon as it turns on (Camera tab → Hide me / Hide effects on entry).
